# body line fingerprint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:bodyLineFingerprint`](gmeow-bodyLineFingerprint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/bodyLineFingerprint>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

A line-normalized content fingerprint used for fuzzy email body matching. The normalization policy is an importer/projection concern ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)); this property records the resulting fingerprint.
